name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source project management with work packages, Gantt charts, agile boards and time tracking, backed by PostgreSQL, memcached and a real-time document collaboration server.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated OPENPROJECT_SEED__ADMIN__USER__PASSWORD from the environment variables; OpenProject asks for a new password on the first login.
The first deploy runs the database migrations before the web service starts, which can take a few minutes.
